Job Title: Project Coordinator
Team: Construction
Location: Phoenix, AZ
Employment type: Full-time
Salary: DOE

Our firm has delivered over $5M in projects each month for the past three years and manages $200 million of
assets under construction. You will coordinate subcontractors, permits and weekly site reports.

Requirements:
- Two years of construction project coordination
- Proficiency with Procore or similar software
- OSHA 10 certification
